Owens & Minor sells medical and surgical supplies, consumable healthcare products, and self-manufactured medical brands (such as HALYARD\*, MediChoice, and Medical Action) to hospitals, health systems, and direct-to-consumer home healthcare patients. [](https://www.hmenews.com/article/owens-minor-sells-products-healthcare-services-segment-to-platinum-equity-for-375m)

- **Medical & Surgical Consumables:** Disposable gloves, facial masks, protective gowns, surgical kits, and drapes.

- **Clinical & Patient Care Items:** Needles, syringes, intravenous (IV) products, wound closure products, and urological supplies.

- **Home-Based Care Equipment:** Respiratory and home medical equipment following their acquisition of Rotech.

- **Proprietary Brands:**

Products under their flagship manufacturing names like HALYARD\* and MediChoice.

[](https://www.mdm.com/news/mergers-acquisitions/owens-minor-privately-selling-its-products-and-healthcare-services-unit-for-375m/)

### Services Provided

- **Medical Distribution:** Supplying hospitals and alternate care facilities with logistics and supply chain management.

- **Inventory Solutions:** Customer-owned inventory management and point-of-care replenishment for healthcare networks. [](https://www.owens-minor.com/distribution/customer-owned-inventory-management/)
